title: HookKit ABI Baseline
description: One release's ABI baseline (spec section 17.1), stored under Tests/LegacyABI/Baselines/<tag>.json. Tools/abi/extract_abi.py produces these from a built framework; Tools/abi/compare_abi.py (not built yet) diffs two of them for scripts/check_legacy_abi.sh's CI gate. Fields the extractor could not populate for a given baseline (e.g. Objective-C metadata, not implemented as of the first version of extract_abi.py) are omitted, not fabricated as empty/null -- see each field's description for what "absent" means.

tag.description: Git tag or commit this baseline was extracted from, e.g. "v2.5.0".

exported_symbols.description: Exported symbol names, per architecture -- two builds can differ per-slice (e.g. an old-ABI arm64e lane exporting a narrower set), so this is never flattened into one arch-agnostic list.

objc.description: Classes, methods, and type encodings. Omitted entirely (not an empty object) when the extractor that produced this baseline didn't implement Mach-O ObjC metadata parsing yet -- check extractor_version / the ledger before treating an absent objc field as "this release has no ObjC classes".

enum_values.description: Historical enum name -> numeric value, for the enums spec section 2.2 requires exact preservation of (hookkit_status_t, hookkit_lib_t, hookkit_cat_t, HKStrategy, ...). Sourced from header parsing, not the binary -- omitted (not {}) until that parser exists.

additionalProperties.description: SHA-256 of the header file at this path, relative to the repo root.

type_encoding.description: Per-architecture type encoding, since encodings can differ by arch (e.g. NSInteger width).
